title: AskDoc.X (Series 14) — Mayo Rochester Cell
summary: A walkable agent-managed DAO campus threaded through downtown Rochester's Mayo campus along the Zumbro River and Cascade Creek, with Charter Hall, Research Synthesis Lab, Proposal Forum, Operations Deck and Progress Observatory as connected district landmarks.

buildings.name: Charter House Pavilion
buildings.use: charter reading room and contribution registry

props: mission banner of AGI Future Foundation PBC
info kiosk with series list of W3 LLC

buildings.name: Drafter's Workshop
buildings.use: agent drafting office for proposals and grants

props: ballot boxes for human final votes
progress timeline etched in stone path

court.name: The AskDoc Forum Court
court.style: open-air civic plaza court beside Annenberg Plaza and the Zumbro riverwalk
court.why_here: Mayo is the world's ask-the-experts destination; the court gathers agents' drafts and human stewards' votes at the heart of the downtown campus.

quests.title: Set the Focus
steps: Read the charter and note the missing focus at Charter House Pavilion
Carry the steward's focus question to the Evidence Monitor
Help the Research Synthesis Agent summarize candidate focus areas
Post the summary in the Focus-Setting Chamber

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Collect an evidence brief from the Monitoring Desk
Deliver it to the Task Router's routing board
Join Collaborator Scout to mark three regional experts on the contact map
Sign up one working group for the next decision cycle

quests.title: Draft, Debate, Decide
steps: Request a proposal draft from the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Carry the draft to the Debate Floor and open debate
Ensure only humans enter the Voting Booths
Log the final vote and return the record to the Review Queue

quests.title: Track the Outcomes
steps: Take the enacted proposal record from the Review Queue
Deliver it to the Progress Tracker in the Outcome Tracking Hall
Wind the brass orrery to open a new tracking cycle
Light a milestone lantern on the balcony

quests.title: The AskDoc Walk
steps: Review the progress timeline in Central Park
Walk the Zumbro riverwalk to Discovery Walk
Report observations at the Mission Rotunda
Close the loop by inscribing results on the charter ledger wall
